title: Lift Off
summary: Use the throttle to leave the pad, climb through the ring, and set it back down.

lines.text: Let's start with the left stick. Pushing it up and down sets how hard the motors spin.
More throttle, more lift. Watch the left stick on the radio while I go up.
Somewhere in the middle there's a point where the quad just floats. That's your hover.
A clean takeoff: one firm push to get clear of the ground, then ease off.
Hold too much and you'll shoot up. Too little and you'll sink. Small corrections win.

practice.instruction: Left stick only: take off, climb up through the ring, then land back on the pad.
